title: Make His Face Shine Upon Us

request.style: English, powerful male rock voice with soaring tenor, electric guitar, heavy drums, bass, piano, epic choir backing, anthemic and triumphant mood, 95 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
May God be gracious to us and bless us
And make his face shine upon us
His light breaks through the morning
A mercy that we cannot earn

[Chorus]
Let your way be known on earth
Your salvation among all nations
Let the peoples praise you, O God
Let all the peoples praise you

[Verse]
The nations are glad and sing for joy
For you judge the peoples with fairness
You guide them upon the earth
A path of justice and grace

[Chorus]
Let your way be known on earth
Your salvation among all nations
Let the peoples praise you, O God
Let all the peoples praise you

[Bridge]
Your hand reaches out to all
No boundary holds your love
The world turns to see your light
And bows before your throne

[Outro]
May God be gracious to us
And make his face shine upon us
